## Design decisions (this row's)

- **`execution_key` derives inside the view** — `completion:<id>` on a
  1:1 completion link, else `run-row:<object name>` (object name only —
  the gs:// bucket locator stays never-exported), else `repo:<path>`,
  else `report:<id>`; a shared run never lends its completion id.
- **`code_identity` is a packaged object** — connector name/version +
  code_commit under the C-13 ownership rule; `"unknown"` folds to
  `not_recorded`; the basis names the ownership, never the absence class.
- **`mode`/`kind` are stored, not derived** — the run-row metadata is
  recorded evidence (WORM docs, repo records, the `live` writer); NULL on
  rows written pre-change, never fabricated.
- **per-source `executions.jsonl` for sources the view reports** — a
  data-bearing source with no execution emits no rows; the
  `run_record_missing` flag (already emitted) names the absence for the
  page side (SIG-TRANSP-037; the page renders under P36.47/P36.69).
